# Conflicting placed Value property fixtures

These small, tooling-owned schematics are synthetic and not for manufacture.
The fault repeats J1's direct placed-symbol `Value` property with conflicting
values. Controls cover a unique property, a repeated property with the same
value, and a conflicting duplicate in the embedded library definition while
the placed instance retains its own value. Native evidence is pinned to KiCad
10.0.8.
